usedFor: DitCal holds the bookings, and Google Drive receives file copies or access through “Copy a File” and “Share File”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in DitCal, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each booking can copy a prepared file into a chosen folder, with a new name if you set one.

watchOut: “Meeting Rescheduled” in DitCal fires on a reschedule, so the same booking can copy a file twice.
